issues.title: Computed-style contrast reported 19 light / 6 dark failures
issues.status: CLOSED - harness defect, not a book defect
issues.detail: The probe compared a container element's inherited colour with an ancestor background that is not the pixels behind the text (reconstructed pages nest publisher colour bands). The pixel measurement of the exact element box returns 22 of 22 samples passing WCAG AA in both themes (cover title 14.6/16.0, body 21.0/14.1, module heading 8.9/4.9, LG badge 7.0/7.0, disclosure summary 18.9/11.1, photo credit 21.0/14.1, rail rows 6.9/5.5 linked and 5.5/5.7 muted, toolbar 18.1/10.1, tools labels 10.3/10.6).

issues.title: Disclosure audit first reported all 155 panels visible while closed
issues.status: CLOSED - harness defect, not a book defect
issues.detail: Chrome keeps a layout box for the slotted content of a closed <details>, so a child rect is meaningless. Re-measured with the details box, checkVisibility() and hit testing: 155/155 hidden when closed (summary-only height, checkVisibility false) and 155/155 shown when open (box grows by the panel height).

issues.title: Navigation scan first reported 19 links not landing precisely
issues.status: CLOSED - harness defect, not a book defect
issues.detail: The scan clicked 453 links with 80 ms between clicks, which outruns the reader's settle; the 19 flagged rows were re-clicked with a 2.5 s settle and all 19 land at 14 px below the toolbar with the correct hash and region. The ten rows without an active Contents highlight are the ten group headers, which are not Contents rows.

issues.title: Keyboard sub-tests initially found no focus ring and no Enter activation
issues.status: CLOSED - harness defect, not a book defect
issues.detail: Programmatic .focus() does not trigger :focus-visible, and my synthetic Enter lacked the char event. Re-run with real Tab and Enter/Space key events plus a control <details>: the focus ring is a solid 2 px outline with :focus-visible true, a Contents link activated with Enter navigates to a 14 px landing, and the extension disclosure toggles on both Enter and Space.

issues.title: TMP-0715 disclosure opens onto a single glyph
issues.detail: The supplied capture prints the info glyph inside the box and the description paragraph below it. The reader reproduces both, and the paragraph is present in the region text.
issues.evidence: details in DISCLOSURE_AUDIT.json; source PNG Page 701-800/B2P1-0715.png inspected

issues.title: TMP-0428 extended description is only six words
issues.detail: The description names the flowchart stages and no fuller description exists in the supplied capture.

issues.title: 31 regions render with no content
issues.detail: 30 are pale/blank source pages and 3 are merged interaction-state references; per-region RGB extrema and classification are recorded, and the reader shows nothing rather than inventing content.

issues.title: Search only covers the reconstructed text, not the page images
issues.detail: The reader carries 1,426,177 characters of reconstructed text; a term that exists only inside a capture image (for example "opportunity cost") returns no match. Searching the 1,899 images was never part of the accepted design.

issues.title: 24 data-classified tables have rows with different cell counts
issues.detail: All 24 are reconstruction layout tables (photograph credit strips, figure compositions, disclosure panels inside a cell). All 12 OCR financial tables are structurally regular.
